module: High-level manager of a rally's recce recordings. It loads the driveline (timestamped points of the driven route, via recce/drivelineRecording) and the cuts (the co-driver's voice markers with their transcriptions, via recce/cutsRecording), draws them in debug, and converts the cuts into pacenote data (createPacenotesData) from a snaproad. It is mainly used by the worldEditor's rally editor (recce import and visualization).
usage:
local Recce = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/recce')
local recce = Recce(missionDir)
recce:loadDrivelineAndCuts()
local pacenotes = recce:createPacenotesData(notebook)
notes: The module returns a constructor: Recce(missionDir) creates the object and calls init.
loadDrivelineAndCuts always returns true; _loadedDrivelineAndCuts is only true if the driveline AND at least one cut were found (checkable with drivelineAndCutsLoaded).
createPacenotesData depends on editor_rallyEditor.getPrefDefaultRadius(): it therefore only works if the rally editor is loaded.
createPacenotesData merges consecutive cuts falling on the same snaproad point: the duplicate's text is appended (separated by a space) to the previous pacenote's note.

Probable inconsistency: createPacenotesData calls Snaproad(self) with the Recce object, whereas Snaproad reads driveline().points (rallyManager passes it a PointList); the Recce's driveline is in self.driveline.
The RecceSettings are commented out in this file (unused).

C.desc: Recce object returned by the module's constructor.

init.desc: Initializes the object: stores missionDir, marks driveline/cuts as not loaded and resets the state.

drivelineAndCutsLoaded.desc: Indicates whether driveline and cuts were successfully loaded by loadDrivelineAndCuts.

_resetState.desc: Sets self.driveline and self.cuts back to nil.

loadDrivelineAndCuts.desc: Loads the driveline then the cuts, logs a warning for each if missing (normal for a new recce).

loadCuts.desc: Loads the cuts with their transcriptions into self.cuts.

returns.desc: true if there is at least one cut
false if the file is absent or invalid

drawDebugRecce.desc: Draws the driveline (via PointList:drawDebug) then the cuts. Does nothing without a driveline.

drawLabels.desc: Show the labels of the driveline points

mouseInfo.desc: Not used in the function body

drawDebugCuts.desc: Draws each cut as a small car, with its transcription text.

drawLittleCar.desc: Draws with debugDrawer a schematic car (4.4 x 1.8 x 1.6 m, four wheels as spheres, body as a prism) centered on pos and oriented by quat; displays txt behind it if provided.

quat.desc: Orientation (the front is the local +Y axis)

createPacenotesData.desc: Converts the cuts into pacenote tables for a notebook: creates a Snaproad on the driveline, places for each cut a "corner end" waypoint as close as possible to the cut and a "corner start" set back by about 2 times the default radius, names the note (Import_<id> ... or Pacenote ...) and puts the transcription in it in the default co-driver language.

returns.desc: List of pacenote tables; nil if driveline/cuts not loaded
